visibleEvidence: The triangular pyramid can produce a triangular section by itself, a pointed section through its apex or a flat-topped section cutting across its side faces. C instead needs the lower rim of the middle frustum to project beyond its square support on both sides of a single plane.
presentation: The pyramid apex and surrounding circular rim can be located in both reference views. B is small but clearly triangular, and the overhangs in C are unambiguous.
